content: Spelling correction BIBREF16 is often viewed as a sub-task of grammatical error correction BIBREF17 , BIBREF18 . Classic methods rely on a source language model and a noisy channel model to find the most likely correction for a given word BIBREF19 , BIBREF20 . Recently, neural techniques have been applied to the task BIBREF7 , BIBREF21 , which model the context and orthography of the input together. Our work extends the ScRNN model of BIBREF7 .
